question: Suppose an individual lose control over his car and it goes off road:
options: Press breaks slowly and keep the vehicle under control.
Get on the road when vehicle is under control.
explanation: You have to keep note of all of the above points in case of out of control vehicle.

question: What should you keep in mind while entering a highway from private road?
options: Match your speed to the highway speed.
Give way to the vehicles already going the highway, they have the right-of-way.
Be careful of other drivers on the highway as they are going at a higher speed.
explanation: You have to take care of all of the mentioned points while entering the highway from a private road.

question: Demerit points expire from your license after how many years?
explanation: Demerit points on your license will automatically expire after 2 years.

question: As a G1 or G2 license holder, if you accumulate 9 or more demerit points within 2 years, how long your license will be suspended?
explanation: if you accumulate 9 or more demerit points within 2 years, your license will be suspended for 60 days.

question: What is correct about Highway 407?
options: A superhighway that connects all highways across Ontario.
It is an express toll route.
explanation: Highway 407 is an express till route which is a fast route.

question: Suppose you get exhausted while driving your vehicle, what should you do?
options: Speed up so you can complete your journey before time.
Drink some coffee and continue driving.
Get to your home and get some rest.
Stop your car and get some rest, continue driving afterwards.
explanation: Do not drive your car while you are exhausted.

question: Under what condition your vehicle has highest chance to slip on the road?
options: First rain, after a dry spell.
explanation: After the first rain, your car has the highest chance of slipping.

question: Most of car slips occur due to:
explanation: Do not drive fast, it is one of the most common reason for slipping vehicle on the road.

question: How can you control your vehicle if it starts slipping?
options: Steer in the direction of slip.
Continue steering in direction of the road.
explanation: You must steer your vehicle in the direction of the slip to gain control over your vehicle.

question: Suppose a new driver gets caught while drinking and driving, for how long his license will be suspended?
explanation: If a new driver is caught while drinking and driving, license will be suspended for 30 days.

question: What should you do in case of roadway blockage right after an intersection?
options: Enter the intersection slowly and move with caution.
Come to a complete stop before entering intersection. Do not block the intersection.
explanation: You should drive carefully, give the right-of-way to others so road don't get blocked.

question: What should you do if lights are not working at an intersection?
options: Come to a complete stop till lights start working.
Treat it as a four way stop sign.
explanation: You should treat the intersection as a four way stop sign if the lights stop working.

question: What does a broken white line mean on street?
explanation: Broken line separates the street whether it's one way or two-way street.

question: What should you keep in mind while approaching a construction area?
options: Speed up and pass through dangerous area faster.
Come to a complete stop, proceed when construction is complete.
Use horn to aware construction workers.
explanation: You should slow down your vehicle and drive carefully near a construction area.

question: What is the two second law?
options: It is used to calculate speed of vehicle.
It is used to determine if your car is unintentionally tailgating.
explanation: The 2 second law while driving helps the driver determine if their car is at a minimum safe distance from the car in the front.

question: Hydroplaning could be prevented by:
options: Ensure tires have proper air pressure.
Drive slowly and carefully while driving in rain.
explanation: Take care of all of the above points for preventing hydroplaning.

question: Suppose an individual accumulates 15 demerit points and license gets suspended, what will happen after 30 days?
options: Points on his driver license is reduced to 12.
Points on his driver license is reduced to 10.
Points on his driver license is reduced to 7.
Points on his driver license is reduced to 5.
explanation: After 30 days, his demerit points will be reduced to seven.

question: If you have G1 or G2 license and you accumulate 9 or more demerit points during a 2 year period, after getting your license suspended for 60 days what will happen?
options: Your record will be reduced to 4 points.
Your record will be reduced to 5 points.
Your record will be reduced to 6 points.
Your record will be reduced to 7 points.
explanation: After a 60 day license suspension, demerit points will be reduced to 4.

question: Suppose you see a flashing yellow traffic light above intersection, what does it mean?
options: It means speed up and cross road as it will turn red.
Come to a complete stop and move when it turns green.
explanation: A flashing amber light at the intersection means that you can continue moving with caution.

question: If you are towing a trailer with your vehicle, which of the following are you not permitted to carry on your trailer?
explanation: Passengers are not allowed in the trailer while you are towing it with a vehicle.
